cause: Every Seal and Reveal run answered 401 from the ledger endpoint. The API key held in the repository secret OXINSIDER_API_KEY was revoked by a routine key rotation on the account that owned it -- one active key per user -- so the mirror could not read a ledger that the backend was serving normally the whole time. Fixed by making the read keyless: the endpoint is public and the workflows send no credential.
notes: start is the first run that failed, Reveal at 2026-09-22T14:51:23Z. end is the first successful ledger fetch after it, logged at 2026-09-22T18:39:07Z by Seal run 35768564494. Runs between those two instants could not copy a hash into this repository. A pick whose kickoff falls inside this window and whose hash therefore reached this repository late is recorded with "outage": "2026-09-22-mirror-401" and stays unproven: the window explains the gap, it does not close it.
